context.situation: I run a small community organisation delivering part of a funded arts and health programme. We hold the relationships that the programme depends on. Twice I have written to raise a concern about delivery decisions being made without the delivery team present. Both times the response came from the steering group rather than from anyone I work with. Since then I have been given less notice of meetings. I have heard informally that funding is tightening and that our contract may not be renewed. I do not know whether raising the concern is the reason.
context.whatMatters: Protecting our role and the community relationships the programme depends on.
context.stakeholders: Our organisation, charity, funder, programme participants, community.
context.uncertainties: Whether the reduced notice/non-renewal risk is connected to raising governance concerns.
context.urgency: High because contract status is uncertain.

evidence.text: I wrote twice about delivery decisions made without the delivery team.
Both replies came from the steering group, not from colleagues I work with.
I have received less notice of meetings since.
I have heard informally that our contract may not be renewed.
We hold most of the direct relationships with participants.
I do not know whether raising the concern is connected.
Funding across the sector is tightening.
